author: cskiraly
content:
I like the idea of more smaller blocks in a slot. Just a note that I had a somewhat similar proposal called Rapidblocks, although I was focusing on the multi-builder aspect of it. 

Anyway, one of the issues we have I think is the 1-1 coupling between the build granularity and the consensus "slot". The two doesn't have to be the same, and that unlocks various pipelining opportunities, whether same builder or between builders.

author: terencechain
content: You lose the slight (20%) faster finality in that world, with the tradeoffs even better UX but more spec complexity. It also feels less forward compatible with decoupled consensus but i haven't studied closely there
